scope: Original living small dicynodont with primary skull, postcranial description and photographed articulated skeleton anchors. Tusked morph without asserting sex.

anchors: Iziko paired articulated skeleton display photograph

scale.basis: Artist nominal model dimensions only, NOT measurements of pictured fossil. Relative soft-tissue volumes and tail extension reconstructed.

pose: Quiet four-foot stance, short bent forelimbs directed somewhat outward/backward, hindlimbs more underneath hips; cylindrical trunk raised clear of floor. Head -Y, small relaxed tail; no burrow/stand or implied behavioral event.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed solid geometry, single-sided opaque materials, subtle planar sculpting; no DoubleSide sheets, detached bead limbs or noisy repeated detail. Integument and colors artistic, not preserved facts.

coordinates.origin: Ground-contact footprint center: horizontal bounding-box midpoint of 41 unique exact exported vertices at Z0 (glTF Y0), covering all four soles; keep the asset root and every mesh transform identity. Not the whole head/trunk/tail projected bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect head/trunk/limb/tail silhouette and four grounded feet before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Tusked and tuskless morphotypes occur; do not assert this individual male or universal tusks in all Diictodon. Juvenile versus adult skull proportions differ.

Iziko image is a firsthand photographer image of a museum display, not a collection catalogue or verified unmodified fossil record. Restoration status/catalogue numbers unverified. Do not infer specimen measurements from perspective or copy its crushed/curling posture.
Photo caption claims about sex, hibernation and cause of death are NOT adopted. Ray & Chinsamy locomotion/digging interpretations are hypotheses, not a required action pose.
Ray & Chinsamy2003 full PDF not accessed: shell Wiley403 respected; only publicly readable primary abstract supports postcranial summary. No assertion that its figures were viewed.
Ray2006 comparison PDF has mainly Wadiasaurus/Lystrosaurus figures, NOT Diictodon geometry. Retained research context only, excluded as visual template.

Kümmell2020 Fig5A is Diictodon carpus; Fig5B/C other taxa and Fig4 other synapsids. Carpal reduction is not toe loss; selected plate does not directly establish all distal toe/claw shapes. Five small digits per foot are conservative generalized reconstruction, exact phalangeal morphology unclaimed.
Living beak margin, skin, color, tail and body volume are artistic; no giant pinnae, furry modern rodent coat, armored scales or mammal nose leather claimed. No image textures/scan mesh reuse.

morphology.obligation: Compact broad-cheeked skull with relatively short narrowing snout and blunt keratinous beak region; small lateral eyes and closed jaw. Exactly two moderate upper tusks beside beak, down-directed with slight backward curvature, no lower tusks or exposed skeletal temporal holes.
morphology.source: Rabe2024 Fig1 skull views and tusked-morph discussion; actual Iziko skull/tusk pixels. Beak soft margin art.

morphology.obligation: Compact cylindrical torso, short neck, short limbs; no sprawling pancake belly or elephant columns. Shoulder/hip transitions coherent, belly above floor. Forelimbs modestly more lateral than hindlimbs, not extreme mole shovels.
morphology.source: Ray & Chinsamy2003 abstract and actual articulated Iziko skeleton photograph. Neutral joint angles art.

morphology.obligation: Longer/wider forefeet with restrained elongated blunt claws; smaller hindclaws. Five compact toes per foot as generalized reconstruction, not exact fossil-distal measurement; no rake-like needle claws or exaggerated giant manus.
morphology.source: Ray & Chinsamy2003 primary abstract; Kümmell2020 Fig5A carpus contextual only.

morphology.obligation: One short tapering tail naturally rooted at rump, no tuft/fan, not long lizard whip. Exact length artistic rather than claimed preserved outline.
morphology.source: Conservative whole-body reconstruction; selected fossils do not fix distal soft outline.

acceptance_obligations: Four exact-finalGLB views front/side/top/perspective: front paired moderate upper tusks/blunt beak and bilateral forefeet; side short head/cylindrical body/short bent limbs and belly clearance; top coherent finite-width head/trunk and limb connections; perspective four feet grounded, rear feet/tail visible, tusks not crossing jaw or floor.

Must not read as Thrinaxodon or modern rodent: beak plus exactly two upper tusks, robust compact cylindrical torso, short limbs and differential fore/hind feet. No buck teeth, huge ear flaps, fur puffs or enormous tusks.
Feet cannot be floating/clipped/bead stacks. If toe/claw details not assessable in standard four, add only targeted foot diagnostic; declare interpretive distal anatomy.

Two complete isolated deterministic factory-startup builds, semantic digest/count comparison; shared default asset_common/render_candidate_views helpers, EXPORT exactly one identity asset-named root, closed opaque single-sided solids.
Independent morphology QA separate from maker. Full static8/GPU/runtime/scene/user acceptance remains unclaimed.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.

revision_scope.allowed_change: Uniform local geometry translation only to satisfy the existing footprint-center requirement. Original scientific morphology, scale, palette and reconstruction limits are unchanged.
